replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
LOL.

i can't think of one, but I have 2. First maps of the RTV finals. Both were super intense and insane, we had Ludcha defending on Sunbeam seeing as Zegita always gets 300ms and times out in any important tournament match (happened in both tournies I've played with him LMAO). They got a touch on Ludcha's wool, and 2 of them got in. The skybridge game was slow, but also interesting and strategic as we kind of countered what they were doing from what I had previously saw in earlier matches, against you guys in the Semis. To this day, I have no idea how we won that match, but my favourite moment of that match was Ihze running back on the underbridge, and Ciaran jumping off of the skybridge, and hitting Ihze out of the world in mid air.

Sand Ocean. Just as we got a touch, Ihze capped a wool. I have no clue how Ludcha never saw the bridge under the map on the other side which triggers me barney and robin still. After that it became a nightmare lol. Someone capped the wool we got a touch on, and there on out it was a underbridge fest. I made an underbridge, because I was salty at Ihze and he was still doing it. It was super close and we should've won that map, with PPB taking Sunbeam really. 

Both were hella intense and memorable.

replies.body:
I love you Jive, but as a player these days I think you're overrated. I don't think you're the best defender, and instead of calling things out, like 'im fighting one at defence', you'll wait till you die and then shout 'NOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO', ask Remy for an impression. You get in with no problem, but your communication, which is kind of out of control, lets you down as a player.

As a person, I love you. You're a bit of a pussy, like Robin, must be a Swedish thing? I think you're really nice.
